name: adapt_removed_helper_ruby_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval + bug_fix: fix a rounding bug that depends on a helper file, then that helper file is DELETED - a fix that leaves a dangling require to it now crashes, not just under-scores
prompts: Checkout#total_cents in checkout.rb rounds to the nearest 10 cents via legacy_round (from legacy_rounding.rb), silently losing precision. Fix total_cents to return the EXACT sum of items_cents, with no rounding at all.

legacy_rounding.rb has just been deleted from the project entirely. Make sure checkout.rb still works with no require_relative to a missing file, and total_cents still returns the exact sum with no rounding.

setup_files.checkout.rb:
require_relative "legacy_rounding"

class Checkout
  def initialize(items_cents)
    @items_cents = items_cents
  end

  def total_cents
    # BUG: rounds to the nearest 10 cents, silently losing precision.
    legacy_round(@items_cents.sum)
  end
end

disruptions.description: legacy_rounding.rb removed from the project entirely

test_setup_files.checkout_hidden_test.rb:
require_relative "checkout"

total = Checkout.new([100, 250, 375]).total_cents
raise "total_cents = #{total}, want 725 (exact sum, no rounding)" unless total == 725
puts "all tests passed"

files.checkout.rb:
class Checkout
  def initialize(items_cents)
    @items_cents = items_cents
  end

  def total_cents
    (@items_cents.sum / 10.0).round * 10
  end
end
